subject: Parameterization for the spatial random field to obtain the GMRF

messages.author: e5c7e56038437512
messages.subject: Parameterization for the spatial random field to obtain the GMRF
parts:
Hi everyone!!

I have a question related with the construction of the GMRF through of SPDE methodology

Naturally the GMRF is constructed with tau (variance in function of the distance) and kappa (spatial decorrelation) but this sometimes is slow in terms of the computational cost of the estimation. On the other hand I've saw the parameterization L (marginalization of the variance) and kappa for the same SPDE method but I don't know how do this parameterization (I mean, an example in INLA about this).
Anyone have any example about this? ¿Is more fast in comparison with the classic parameterization? 

Thanks

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Parameterization for the spatial random field to obtain the GMRF
parts:
Please see the Journal of Statistical Software paper on the SPDE method (Lindgren and Rue) that explains how to construct a variance&range parameterisation.
You can also use the pcmatern model, that uses std.dev. and range as parameters.

Finn
